lab.orderDetails.deleteConfirm:
Delete this lab order permanently?

This removes the laboratory's copy: the order, its samples and its results.

The breeder keeps the confirmed genetics on their animal, and keeps their certificate.

This cannot be undone. To take the order off the dashboard without losing it, use Archive instead.
